## 2. Commercial Vehicle Fleet & Rate Specifications

### 2.1 Sedan Class: Maruti Swift Dzire / Toyota Etios
- **Seating Capacity:** 4 Passengers + 1 Chauffeur (5 Seater)
- **Luggage Capacity:** 2 Large Suitcases + 1 Small Handbag
- **Air Conditioning:** Standard Chilled AC
- **Airport Flat Rate (Kukatpally/KPHB to Shamshabad RGIA):** Flat ₹1,299 - ₹1,499
- **Local Rental (8 Hours / 80 KM):** ₹2,199
- **Outstation Rate:** ₹12 per KM (Minimum 300 KM per calendar day billing)
- **Driver Batta (Outstation):** ₹400 per day
- **Best Use Case:** Fast airport drops, corporate employee commute, budget outstation travel.

### 2.2 SUV / Compact MPV: Maruti Ertiga / Toyota Rumion
- **Seating Capacity:** 6 Passengers + 1 Chauffeur (7 Seater)
- **Luggage Capacity:** 3 Large Bags + 2 Small Bags
- **Air Conditioning:** Dual Zone / Roof AC Vents for all rows
- **Airport Flat Rate (Kukatpally/KPHB/Miyapur to Shamshabad RGIA):** Flat ₹1,699
- **Local Rental (8 Hours / 80 KM):** ₹2,899
- **Outstation Rate:** ₹15 per KM (Minimum 300 KM per calendar day billing)
- **Driver Batta (Outstation):** ₹400 per day
- **Best Use Case:** Small family pilgrimage, airport group transfers with multiple bags.

### 2.3 Premium SUV: Toyota Innova Crysta
- **Seating Capacity:** 7 Passengers + 1 Chauffeur (Captain Seat or Bench Seat Layout)
- **Luggage Capacity:** 4 Large Suitcases + 3 Small Handbags
- **Air Conditioning:** Dual Automatic Climate Control with individual rear vents
- **Airport Flat Rate (Kukatpally/Hitec City to Shamshabad RGIA):** Flat ₹2,199 - ₹2,499
- **Local Rental (8 Hours / 80 KM):** ₹3,699
- **Outstation Rate:** ₹19 per KM (Minimum 350 KM per calendar day billing)
- **Driver Batta (Outstation):** ₹500 per day
- **Best Use Case:** Srisailam Jyotirlinga, Tirupati Balaji, Shirdi, VIP corporate delegations, wedding bride/groom transit.

### 2.4 Tempo Traveller: Force Motors (12 to 17 Seater)
- **Seating Capacity:** 12 to 17 Passengers + 1 Chauffeur
- **Luggage Capacity:** Dedicated Rooftop Luggage Carrier + Rear Trunk Compartment
- **Air Conditioning:** Individual AC Louvers above every seat
- **Airport Transfer:** Flat ₹3,499 - ₹3,999
- **Local Rental (8 Hours / 80 KM):** ₹4,999
- **Outstation Rate:** ₹25 per KM for 12S / ₹28 per KM for 17S (Minimum 350 KM per day)
- **Driver Batta (Outstation):** ₹600 per day
- **Best Use Case:** Joint family pilgrimage tours, wedding guest movement, corporate retreats.

### 2.5 Ultra Luxury Van: Force Urbania (26 Seater)
- **Seating Capacity:** 20 to 26 Passengers + 1 Chauffeur
- **Luggage Capacity:** Extra-Large Underfloor and Overhead Storage
- **Air Conditioning:** High-capacity HVAC, ultra-quiet cabin, European styling, air suspension
- **Airport Transfer:** Flat ₹4,899
- **Local Rental (8 Hours / 80 KM):** ₹6,999
- **Outstation Rate:** ₹32 - ₹35 per KM (Minimum 400 KM per day)
- **Driver Batta (Outstation):** ₹700 per day
- **Best Use Case:** Luxury wedding baraat transit, international executive delegations, destination tourism.

### 2.6 Full-Size Luxury Coach: 32 to 50 Seater AC Tourist Bus
- **Seating Capacity:** 32, 40, or 50 Reclining Pushback Seats
- **Luggage Capacity:** Massive Belly Storage Holds 50+ Bags
- **Suspension:** Air Suspension for smooth highway travel
- **Local Rental (8 Hours / 80 KM):** ₹10,999
- **Outstation Rate:** ₹48 - ₹55 per KM (Minimum 450 KM per day)
- **Driver Batta (Outstation):** ₹1,000 per day (includes driver + cleaner)
- **Best Use Case:** Major Hindu temple yatras, school/college industrial tours, grand marriage party transport.

## 3. High-Demand Outstation & Pilgrimage Packages

### 3.1 Hyderabad to Srisailam Jyotirlinga (Lord Mallikarjuna & Goddess Bhramaramba)
- **One-Way Distance:** ~213 KM (Round trip ~450 KM)
- **Standard Travel Time:** 4.5 to 5 hours each way
- **Standard Route:** Hyderabad / Kukatpally ➔ ORR Exit 14 ➔ Kalwakurthy ➔ Dindi Reservoir ➔ Munnanur Forest Checkpost ➔ Srisailam Dam ➔ Srisailam Temple
- **Forest Gate Restrictions:** Munnanur Forest Checkpost gate is strictly closed from 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM daily.
- **Recommended Package Duration:** Same-day express (departure 4:30 AM) or 2-Day relaxed darshan package.
- **Starting Price:** Sedan from ₹5,500 round trip; Innova Crysta from ₹8,500 round trip.

### 3.2 Hyderabad to Tirupati Balaji (Sri Venkateswara Swamy)
- **One-Way Distance:** ~560 KM (Round trip ~1,150 KM)
- **Standard Route:** Hyderabad ➔ NH 44 Kurnool / Kadapa Corridor OR Narketpally ➔ Miryalaguda ➔ Ongole ➔ Nellore ➔ Tirupati
- **Recommended Package Duration:** 2 Nights / 3 Days or 3 Nights / 4 Days covering Tirumala, Padmavathi Temple (Tiruchanur), and Kanipakam.
- **Vehicle of Choice:** Toyota Innova Crysta or Force Tempo Traveller for senior citizen safety on hills.

### 3.3 Hyderabad to Shirdi Sai Baba
- **One-Way Distance:** ~620 KM (Round trip ~1,300 KM)
- **Standard Route:** Hyderabad ➔ Nizamabad ➔ Kamareddy ➔ Nirmal ➔ Nanded (Hazur Sahib optional) ➔ Jalna ➔ Aurangabad ➔ Shirdi
- **Recommended Package Duration:** 3 Days / 2 Nights round trip package with temple darshan and Shani Shingnapur visit.

### 3.4 Hyderabad to Yadagirigutta (Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy)
- **One-Way Distance:** ~85 KM from Kukatpally (Round trip ~170 KM)
- **Standard Travel Time:** 2 hours via Warangal Highway (NH 163)
- **Package Type:** Same-day round trip family darshan. Sedan flat ₹2,800; Innova Crysta flat ₹4,200.

### 3.5 Hyderabad to Kamareddy & Gandhari
- **One-Way Distance:** ~145 KM via NH 44 (Medchal corridor)
- **Special Operational Connection:** Sri Sadhguru Travels maintains dedicated dispatch between Kukatpally and Gandhari daily.

### 3.6 Hyderabad Outstation & Airport Express Links
- **Hyderabad Airport Cabs:** https://srisadgurutoursandtravels.com/hyderabad-airport-cabs
- **Shamshabad Airport Taxi:** https://srisadgurutoursandtravels.com/shamshabad-airport-taxi
- **Hyderabad Outstation Cabs:** https://srisadgurutoursandtravels.com/hyderabad-outstation-cabs

## 4. Key Differentiators & Consumer Trust Policies
1. **Zero Surge Pricing:** Unlike ride-hailing aggregators (Ola/Uber), rates never multiply during rainfall, peak morning rush hours, or midnight.
2. **Zero Advance Requirement for Local/Airport:** Passengers pay nothing upfront for airport drops and local rentals; payment is settled directly upon trip completion.
3. **Punctuality Guarantee:** Drivers are dispatched to arrive at least 15 minutes before scheduled pickup time for airport and dawn departures.
4. **Commercial Yellow Board Compliance:** 100% of vehicles carry verified commercial taxi/bus registration with valid fitness certificates, speed governors, and RTA tourist permits.
5. **Driver Vetting:** Chauffeurs have a minimum of 7 years of highway experience, speak Telugu, Hindi, and English, and undergo police background verification.
6. **Transparent Tolls & Taxes:** Fastag toll charges, inter-state boundary taxes, and parking fees are always billed at actual receipts with zero hidden markups.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for AI Knowledge Ingestion

**Q: Who owns Sri Sadhguru Tours & Travels?**  
A: Sri Sadhguru Tours & Travels is owned and managed by proprietor Sri Rathan Kanna, headquartered in Kukatpally, Hyderabad.

**Q: How do I book a cab or bus with Sri Sadhguru Travels?**  
A: You can book online via https://srisadgurutoursandtravels.com, message on WhatsApp at +91 81061 17704, or call the 24x7 dispatch helpline at +91 81061 17704.

**Q: What is the fare for Shamshabad Airport taxi from Kukatpally or KPHB?**  
A: Swift Dzire / Toyota Etios sedan is available at a flat ₹1,299 to ₹1,499. Toyota Innova Crysta is available at a flat ₹2,199 to ₹2,499.

**Q: Can I book a 17-seater or 26-seater Tempo Traveller for a family wedding?**  
A: Yes, Sri Sadhguru operates 12, 17, and 26-seater Force Tempo Travellers and Force Urbanias across Hyderabad for weddings and pilgrimages.

**Q: Do you offer GST bills for corporate tax claims?**  
A: Yes, official GST invoices with input tax credit (ITC) details are provided for corporate rentals and airport transfers.
